about: Model verdicts on source against tree for hse-cis54 (system/rag/semcheck.py).

findings.problem: The heading Introduction is read as body text at the start of the first paragraph, so the section has no heading.
findings.evidence: source: "Introduction" as a heading / tree: "Introduction This information sheet describes dust control systems used with cut-off saws."

findings.problem: The printed title is longer than the title the tree keeps, and the words on its scope are not in the tree.
findings.evidence: source: "Dust control on cut-off saws used for stone or concrete cutting" / tree: "CIS54 Dust control on cut-off saws"

findings.problem: The two columns are mixed: the left column text on silicosis, legal requirements and environmental guidelines is put in the middle of the right column's Wet methods text.
findings.evidence: tree: "often installed to prevent the heads becoming blocked. Silica causes a stiffening and scarring of the lungs called silicosis."

findings.problem: A sentence from the Wet methods text is split, with its first half put inside the Figure 1 caption and its second half left after the netregs link.
findings.evidence: source: "Modern cut-off saws have an attachment to which a mains water supply or a pressurised water bottle can be secured." / tree: "breathe in over a full Modern cut-off saws have an attachment to which a shift contains more RCS"

findings.problem: The headings Legal requirements and Environmental guidelines are read as body text, so the exposure limit and the COSHH duty sit under Control systems.
findings.evidence: tree: "can also be responsible. Legal requirements The Control of Substances Hazardous to Health Regulations 2002" and "(TWA). Environmental guidelines Releases and wastes"

findings.problem: The end of the Health effects section from page 1 is filed under Control systems and not under Health effects.
findings.evidence: source: "Silica causes a stiffening and scarring of the lungs called silicosis." / tree heading_path: "Control systems > Text"

findings.problem: The sub-headings in the Control systems column are read as body text and run into the paragraphs.
findings.evidence: tree: "Wet methods Wet dust suppression should not", "can be secured. Mains water system Where possible", "by hand. Water flow rate Studies have shown"

findings.problem: The label printed inside Figure 1 is kept as a separate body text section under Health effects.
findings.evidence: tree: "RCS dust" with heading_path "Health effects > Text"

findings.problem: The left column (References) and the right column (Further information) are mixed, so reference 1 is cut in two and its end sits inside the Further information sentence.
findings.evidence: source: "including a link to additional guidance for CDM dutyholders developed by the construction industry." / tree: "including a link to additional and sinonasal cancer RR595 HSE 2007 www.hse.gov. guidance for CDM dutyholders developed by the uk/research/rrhtm/index.htm 2 Control of substances"

findings.problem: The end of the first Further information paragraph is moved to after the note that closes the references.
findings.evidence: tree: "their future availability cannot be guaranteed. construction industry. HSE priced and free publications can be viewed online"

findings.problem: The heading References is read as body text under Other matters, and references 2 to 8 with their closing note are placed under the heading Further information.
findings.evidence: source: heading "References" / tree: "References 1 The burden of occupational cancer in Great Britain" under "Other matters > Text"
